title: Common event definitions
description: Definitions shared by the event schemas in this folder. Not an event itself.

id.description: Opaque identifier (tenant, order, product, promotion, suggestion, customer). URL-safe; consumers never parse it. The SAD samples (rest_42, ord_501, p_12, sg_77) and UUIDs both fit.

money.description: Integer amount in Toman, currency IRT (SAD 11.1).

channel.description: Channel name, e.g. bale. An open value, not an enum, so a new channel needs no contract change (QA-M1).

customer_ref.description: Channel identity of the customer as <channel>:<external_user_id>, e.g. bale:98123456.

order_line.description: One line of an order with the unit price snapshotted by Order at placement time (SAD 6.4, QA-SEC2).

name.description: Product name snapshotted from the Catalog price quote, so Notification can render a message without the menu. Optional in version 1 because the SAD 7.1 sample omits it; Order always sends it.
